name: Beacon
description: Captures coding agent sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 20+ other harnesses and turns them into shared memory that future agents can search over MCP.

skills.name: Capture Session History
skills.description: Captures prompts, responses, tool calls, commands, file edits, approvals, and token usage from 20+ coding agent harnesses.

skills.name: Search Agent Activity
skills.description: Searches and summarizes captured agent sessions and events through the local Beacon MCP server, without touching the network.

skills.name: Recall Project Memory
skills.description: Retrieves reviewed project memory, such as workflows, corrections, and repo conventions, for the task an agent is working on.

skills.name: Browse Traces
skills.description: Opens a local terminal browser or web dashboard to replay sessions with event timelines, token usage, and file diffs.

skills.name: Forward Telemetry
skills.description: Forwards normalized agent session telemetry to Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, S3, and other destinations.
